Academic High
MIT Sloan · 2026-07-23
  • The coordination cost principle: Each handoff between AI and human requires review, validation, adjustment. Those checkpoints multiply. Allowing AI to execute a full workflow end-to-end — even if individual steps are slightly lower quality — often beats human oversight at each step because coordination cost dominates.

Activity (faster team selection) without the right outcomes (better transformation results).

Academic High
MIT Sloan · 2026-07-23
  • The coordination cost principle: Each handoff between AI and human requires review, validation, adjustment. Those checkpoints multiply. Allowing AI to execute a full workflow end-to-end — even if individual steps are slightly lower quality — often beats human oversight at each step because coordination cost dominates.
  • Task chaining matters more than task perfection: You don't need AI to be better than humans at every step. You need tasks grouped so they execute as a continuous sequence.
  • One broken link breaks the chain: If even one task in a sequence is hard for AI to handle, it undermines the entire workflow.

MIT Sloan: "Chaining Tasks, Redefining Work" (April 2026)
Academic High
MIT Sloan · 2026-07-23
  • The coordination cost principle: Each handoff between AI and human requires review, validation, adjustment. Those checkpoints multiply. Allowing AI to execute a full workflow end-to-end — even if individual steps are slightly lower quality — often beats human oversight at each step because coordination cost dominates.
  • Task chaining matters more than task perfection: You don't need AI to be better than humans at every step. You need tasks grouped so they execute as a continuous sequence.
  • One broken link breaks the chain: If even one task in a sequence is hard for AI to handle, it undermines the entire workflow.

  • The coordination cost principle: Each handoff between AI and human requires review, validation, adjustment. Those checkpoints multiply. Allowing AI to execute a full workflow end-to-end — even if individual steps are slightly lower quality — often beats human oversight at each step because coordination cost dominates.

Allowing AI to execute a full workflow end-to-end — even if individual steps are slightly lower quality — often beats human oversight at each step because coordination cost dominates.
